essence: The placement of these deities is distributed between the center and the tips of the lotus petals.
The worship is complete when the directional lords and their weapons are included as described.
The ritual sequence proceeds from libation and sprinkling to feeding the couple.
Performing recitation and related acts in the manner of a preliminary rite leads to task accomplishment.
The next teaching concerns the supreme Saṃkarṣaṇa mantra.
